premises.text: Designing chemical synthesis is highly inefficient and error-prone because chemists manually dig through scientific publications
premises.evidence_span: Designing how to synthesize a given molecule is highly inefficient and prone to errors

premises.text: AI designs novel synthesis routes from commercially available molecules within seconds, ranked by user criteria and backed by lab-tested evidence
premises.evidence_span: Molecule One leverages artificial intelligence to design novel chemical synthesis within seconds instead of hours or days

premises.text: Deep learning on prior experiments proposes viable transformations assembled into multi-step pathways
premises.evidence_span: It utilizes information about previous experiments to find out what kinds of transformations between different molecules are viable

premises.text: Competitor tools do not use AI on chemical datasets for synthesis planning and struggle to generalize to novel molecules
premises.evidence_span: Software of our competitors does not utilize AI to leverage chemical datasets for synthesis planning and often has trouble generalizing to novel molecules

premises.text: Monetization is SaaS by seats or data points, plus enterprise custom integrations and optional on-premise deployment
premises.evidence_span: We use SaaS paid by number of seats or data points, and we have an enterprise tier with custom integrations and optional on-premise deployment

value.text: Chemists design viable syntheses in seconds so medicines can be made faster

secondary_value.text: Cure patients faster by optimizing synthesis pipelines
